apworld_0.5.0.description:
**New features**
Split Double Jump option:
You can now split the Double jump item into multiple items, that only grant
you the ability to double jump in specific areas:
Quarry + Mine (Double Jump - Quarry+)
Illburn + Lava Zone (Double Jump - Illburn+)
Mountain + Icebound Cave ("Double Jump - Mountain+)
Castle + Dungeons + Clock Tower ("Double Jump - Castle+)
Genos Island ("Double Jump - Genos+)

Room Sanity option:
You can now make it so that entering new rooms sends location checks.
Different amounts to choose from.
Full = 180 extra locations.
No sphere 0 = 143 extra locations.
Only the later parts of every Major Areas = 76 extra locations.
No room sanity = 0 extra locations.

Disable Traps option:
You can now remove all traps from the starting pool.


**Fixes**
Store locations that are out of logic should no longer be able to be sent
when you receive their Vanilla item from another player or from a location
while in the store.

Fixed a bug where exiting Harold's House would not set the flags for the town
in the correct position, putting the town in an unintended and bad state.

Fixed a bug where teleporting to outside Valestein Castle and then walking all
the way to Redmont would also cause the previously mentioned bad state.

Fixed a bug where some connections didn't actually evaluate logic rules correctly.

0.5.1 Edit:
Fixed a bug where Vanilla Double Jump was never actually added to the pool.

**Other**
Stone Shoes now auto-equip in the Clock Tower if the option is on, since
the shoes prevent slipping on the green snail goo.

**Ai Usage**
I gave it all the (ROOM) locations in Locations.py (Lines 196 -> 392)
to convert them into the dict format needed in memory.py (Lines 404 -> 591)
so that I didn't have to do it manually.
e.g
"(ROOM) Redmont - Store #24",
into
"(ROOM) Redmont - Store #24": None,

It taught me more about how dicts and lists works.
